name: Zimbabwe Rhodesia (1979)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and green, with a black vertical band at the hoist bearing a gold Zimbabwe Bird.
history: Adopted on 4 September 1979 by the short-lived state of Zimbabwe Rhodesia created under the Internal Settlement, replacing the Rhodesian green-white-green flag. The Union Flag was restored when the country returned to British rule on 12 December 1979 under the Lancaster House Agreement, and Zimbabwe's flag followed at independence in April 1980.

features.symbolism: red for the struggle for majority rule, white for the role of the white minority, green for the land
